text: Dawn launched in September 2007 on a mission to explore two protoplanets in the asteroid belt: Vesta and Ceres.
Dawn entered orbit around giant asteroid Vesta on July 16, 2011, mapping its battered surface for 14 months.
Dawn entered orbit around dwarf planet Ceres on March 6, 2015, becoming the first spacecraft to orbit two separate extraterrestrial destinations.
Dawn discovered bright deposits of sodium carbonate in Ceres' Occator Crater, evidence of recent subsurface brine activity.
NASA announced on November 1, 2018 that Dawn had depleted its hydrazine attitude-control fuel, ending its communications with Earth.
Dawn remains in a stable uncontrolled orbit around Ceres, where planetary protection rules ensure it will not crash for decades.
